server_offline.title: Server {{server}} is offline
server_offline.body: The agent on {{server}} has not been connected for {{minutes}} minutes. Websites on it may be down.

server_disk.title: Disk almost full on {{server}}
server_disk.body: The disk of {{server}} is {{percent}}% full. Free some space before websites and databases stop writing.

certificate_expiring.title: The certificate of {{name}} expires soon
certificate_expiring.body: It expires on {{date}}. Upload a new one, or switch the site back to a free certificate.

malware_found.title: Possible malware on {{name}}

quota_warning.title: Disk space almost used up
quota_warning.body: {{customer}} uses {{used}} of {{limit}}. When it is full, files and new websites cannot be added.

quota_full.title: Disk space used up
quota_full.body: {{customer}} uses {{used}} of {{limit}}. Files and new websites cannot be added until some space is freed.

bandwidth_full.title: Bandwidth used up
bandwidth_full.body: {{customer}} has used {{used}} of {{limit}} this month. The websites keep working; the package allows going over.

bandwidth_stopped.title: Bandwidth used up: websites stopped
bandwidth_stopped.body: {{customer}} has used {{used}} of {{limit}} this month. Websites and apps show a "bandwidth used up" page until next month or a larger package.

cron_failed.title: Cron job {{name}} failed
cron_failed.body: The last run of {{name}} ({{target}}) failed: {{result}}. You will be told again only after it has worked in between.

login_new_ip.title: New sign-in to your account
login_new_ip.body: Someone signed in to your ekPanel account from {{ip}}. If it was not you, change your password and sign out other devices.

test.title: Test notification from ekPanel
test.body: This channel works. You will get notifications here.

update_available.title: ekPanel {{version}} is available
update_available.body: This panel runs {{current}}. Read what is new and update from Settings → Updates. The panel and every server's agent are updated one after the other.

update_finished.title: ekPanel updated to {{version}}
update_finished.body: The panel runs {{version}}. Agents: {{servers}} servers checked, {{problems}} with a problem. Settings → Updates shows each server.

update_failed.title: Update to ekPanel {{version}} failed
update_failed.body:
{{message}}

The panel keeps running its current version. Settings → Updates has the details.

recovery_code_used.title: A recovery code signed in to your account
recovery_code_used.body: Someone signed in to your ekPanel account from {{ip}} with a two-factor recovery code; {{left}} codes are left. If it was not you, change your password, make new recovery codes and sign out other devices.
